items.raw_excerpt: Following Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay’s announcement to officially drop the proposed greenfield airport at Parandur, social media and political corridors have been consumed by debates over Chennai's aviation capacity, economic growth, and ecological preservation. items.summary_en: A planned airport at Parandur has been cancelled. Local youth in the affected area talk about how the news changes their hopes for jobs and their town. Their career plans are now uncertain.
items.summary_ko: 파란두르에 지어질 예정이던 신공항 계획이 취소됐다. 영향을 받은 지역의 현지 청년들은 이 소식이 일자리와 고장에 대한 기대를 어떻게 바꿀지 이야기한다. 그들의 진로 계획도 다시 불투명해졌다.

items.raw_excerpt: The two new BTO developments in Toa Payoh and Sin Ming will have wait times of less than three years.
items.summary_en: About 1,200 new public flats are planned in Toa Payoh and Sin Ming. Their waiting time will be less than three years. This is shorter than the usual waiting time for public housing.
